GU.block_rule: Every run crossing 192 WLs must split; relaxed away in the lower bound.
GU.status: relaxed mathematical bound; not an executable layout
GU.proof: For phase-block-aligned tight packing of equal 4q+2-page shards, every two adjacent experts share one WL and no other pair shares a WL. For each chip W=K*(q+1)-selected_pairs. Maximum-weight perfect matching minimizes its expected W exactly. Arbitrary chip-specific matchings cannot beat this mean because E[max_chip W] >= max_chip E[W] >= this optimum; identical optimal matchings attain the flash expectation. Control, inactive outputs, block splits and native row legality are relaxed favorably.
GU.other_page_offsets: Even page offsets give the same matching family. At odd offsets, alternating bad experts cost one extra WL while every adjacent expert pair can share one WL: expected W=K*(q+1)+sum_bad P(selected)-sum_path P(both). Split path edges into two matchings; optimal perfect matching weight M is at least half the path-edge weight sum. Each bad expert has at most two neighbors, so path weight sum<=2*sum_bad P(selected). Therefore M>=path_weight_sum-sum_bad P(selected), and an aligned matching has no larger expected read work than any odd-offset order.
GU.inactive_output_note: All covered WL rows must really compute and transfer. Ignoring their extra output makes this a favorable lower bound, never a measured/predicted runtime.
GU.native_limitation: C1536 requires WL start and length multiples of3 for fully row-aligned dense runs; the safe 3WL pair bundle reads3WL even when one expert is selected.

hardware: 16 chips,4planes,16KiB pages,64KiB WL wave,192WL/block,28us ordinary read,250ns command,2us host phase; same input GU only.
coalescing_control: When shard length is a whole WL, tight packing and selected-WL union are exactly ordinary contiguous-run command coalescing on the existing layout. Both candidate and baseline must receive the same learned ordering and run cost. No incremental packing benefit is credited.
MAC_warning: Synthetic sensitivity is specified in ns per64KiB of INT8 matrix MAC work, with max-overlap and serial variants. No PE throughput was measured or inferred from the6.4GB/s ECC/data path.
bound_scope: g16 and g8 equal-row geometry only, as requested initial screen. No bound for arbitrary mixed width/row templates or new native operands is claimed.
